tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background under the moving glow. Ink in dark, paper cream in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid cards when Effects is Off; modal body base.

tokens.name: surface-hi
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control; hovered tab.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg, surface and every glass.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions. Dark value lifted from #A8A399 so it passes 4.5:1 over the brightest glow.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Tile fill. Always with backdrop blur (blur-full or blur-light).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around glass tiles, inputs at rest, table header rule.

tokens.name: glass-dense
tokens.usage: Tables, logs, config editor, modals: long text stays readable.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Bar and ring tracks, skeleton base, neutral badges.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, off toggles, checkboxes, dashed add buttons. 3:1 against glass.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Saffron fill: primary buttons, active tab, logo doorway on This server and login. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Saffron for bars, sparklines, card edges, focus ring. 3:1 on cream and white.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Saffron used as text or icon on a plain ground. 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any accent fill (computed: ink on all twelve accents).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary accent fill (third glow, highlights). Never for status text in light.

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Mint as text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status: online, up, active. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success word on glass.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status: high load, expiring, slow. Orange-red so it never reads as saffron.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning word on glass. Dark value lifted so it passes over a bright glow. Do not lighten the light value.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status: offline, down, expired, destructive.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger word on glass.
